text:
nina_net: Morning all — hitting p99 encode spikes across eu-west racks 3-6. NIC tx queues on host group eu-west-3 show sustained 600kpps bursts, packet drops, and irq storms. GPU utils low.
rob_sched: sounds like noisy neighbor at network layer. Any tenant top talkers?
nina_net: flow-agg shows tenant-streamer (55%), tenant-realtime (20%), infra-sync (10%). Packet sizes tiny, lots of token-by-token RPCs.
celia_sre: did any config push touch egress QoS or global route maps overnight?
nina_net: no config changes. Sudden onset ~01:30UTC. tcptracer indicates many short-lived connections that hold NIC TX rings.
tom_ops: quick mitigation thought: AZ-level egress shaping + a fractional quiet carveout spread across AZs so we don't overload a single AZ. That avoids moving tenants to a single hot slice.
rob_sched: agree. We can create "az-egress-shape-euw" slice replicated across eu-west AZs and mark it with NIC shaping rules (per-host eBPF tbf at 8G). Soft-redirect noisy tenants with 10% weight first.
celia_sre: opsbot create incident and page SRE on threshold p99>250ms for 10m.
buildkite: Incident created INC-2026-5011 "eu-west egress irq storm"; paging thresholds applied.
nina_net: Proposed plan: 1) create az-egress-shape-euw preemptible slice replicated in AZs 3-6; 2) label noisy tenants and soft-redirect 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 10m observation windows; 3) enable per-host eBPF token-bucket shaping on tx queue for shaped slice; 4) capture billing delta.
rob_sched: keep it preemptible to avoid reserved cost spike. Also add scheduler guard: reduce backfill weight for that slice to avoid thrash.
tom_ops: billing note: finance estimates preemptible cost delta ~$1.1k/day if we convert slice to reserved. financebot, can we track current-day delta?
financebot: Tracking enabled; will tag costs under INC-2026-5011.
rob_sched: Quick commands:
```bash
# annotate tenants
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-streamer routing=az-egress-shape-euw
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-realtime routing=az-egress-shape-euw
# set soft weight
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://scheduler.internal/api/v1/routes/weights \
  -d '{"slice":"az-egress-shape-euw","weight":0.1,"region":"eu-west"}'
```
celia_sre: add eBPF probe to measure per-pod tx ring occupancy and per-queue irq rates. Also set alert for oscillation: if p99 improves then degrades by >30% within 20m, rollback and shard slice across more AZs.
nina_net: starting 10% soft-redirect now (02:10UTC). Observation window 10m.
buildkite: Alert suppression active for 8m while mitigation in progress.
rob_sched: 02:22UTC update: p99 improved from 520ms -> 310ms, host tx queue occupancy down ~35%. Good signal. Move to 30% if stable for next 10m.
celia_sre: agree but capture telemetry snapshot for RCA: per-pod pps, ring occupancy, irq rates, and switch egress counters.
tom_ops: doing 30% now. Also keep preemptible flag for slice.
financebot: cost tracker running; tagging to test budget for tenant-streamer.
rob_sched: final note: long term we should push per-tenant pacing into proxy and implement scheduler soft-quotas to prevent backfill-induced thrash. Plan RFC after incident.
nina_net: will draft runbook steps "az-egress-shape soft-redirect" and post in infra-playbooks. Thanks team :thumbsup:
